decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's steel fabrication and fluid-handling know-how and serves its utility customers, so the firm can read market feedback and improve the product.

Public waste bins use the firm's existing metal fabrication and in-house coating skills and reach its public-sector buyers, giving enough related knowledge to refine the multi-model line, though it is a step away from industrial applications.
The ground sleeve line is simple fabricated metal work close to the firm's core competence, and having several models signals commitment and room for learning.

Cast iron lies outside the firm's steel and stainless processing expertise, which limits how well it can absorb and improve on this product, but it completes the ground sleeve range and is cheap to keep in the first year.
Steel ground sleeves fit the firm's core steel processing and surface treatment capabilities, so it can assimilate early results and develop the product further.
